name: Notification 70/2019: one hundred crore rupees from 1 April 2020

attrs.quote: whose aggregate turnover in a financial year exceeds one hundred crore rupees, as a class of registered person who shall prepare invoice in terms of sub-rule (4) of rule 48
attrs.scope: registered persons, for supplies to registered persons
attrs.note: Superseded by notification 13/2020, dated 21 March 2020, before it came into force.
